essence: The prescribed recitation for this mantra is one thousand repetitions equivalent to a year of days.
Performing libation and related rites with the mantra limbs establishes the first enclosure.
The eight-petal enclosure holds Radiance and Splendor, while the ground enclosure holds the divine weapons.
Performing ten thousand oblations with jasmine flowers bestows luster.
One may also perform other applications taught in connection with the eight-syllable mantra.
